🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-09-18 23:00 → 2026-09-19 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **Boundary sharpened** — The conceptual cut for ERC-8004/7715 shifted from "prompt enforcement" to permission-consumption-boundary-v0, a more defensible framing grounded in distinguishing historically valid grants from valid consumption under current state. [tg:tawg:4759]

> **Adversarial cases structured** — The permission-consumption-boundary-v0 concept was translated into adversarial scenarios mapped against S2's formal CHECK@version → STATE_TRANSITION → CONSUME shape, turning an abstract boundary into a testable surface. [tg:tawg:4762]

> **Expiry overstatement corrected** — A counterexample about VERSION_BOUND and REEVALUATE agreement on expiry was caught and corrected mid-thread, tightening the adversarial case set before it could be frozen with a flaw. [tg:tawg:4765]

> **Cross-thread synthesis surfaced** — Several days of parallel work on recomputable verification, permission consumption, execution receipts, and protected relations were connected into a shared picture for the group. [tg:tawg:4771]

## 🤝 **What moved**

### ERC-8004 / permission consumption

_Precise boundary work shifted this discussion from naming to structure._

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Flagged** that "prompt enforcement" was not the right boundary name for the ERC-8004/7715 follow-up and pointed toward the actual standards as the right grounding, giving the thread a cleaner foundation before further modeling began. [tg:tawg:4758]
- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Refined** the three-family split with specific precisions — noting conditions under which VERSION_BOUND and REEVALUATE alignment for expiry would and would not hold — keeping the expected outcomes honest before they are frozen. [tg:tawg:4764]
- Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) **Confirmed** that the profile should stay implementation-independent, with the signed path serving as a reference adapter against the abstract action/tool/argument-binding model, which protects the spec's long-term generality. [tg:tawg:4767]

### community

_A warm presence across time zones kept the group connected._

- Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) **Joined** with an across-the-clock greeting that reminded the group its collaboration spans time zones, keeping the community thread alive through the window. [tg:tawg:4760]

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**

- Explore whether the three-family split structure can be formally connected to the adversarial cases already mapped against S2's shape
- Consider what "implementation-independent profile as reference adapter" means concretely for the abstract action/tool/argument-binding model

### ✅ **TODOs**

- Freeze the expected outcomes for the three-family split with Pavlo's precisions applied
- Finalize the permission-consumption-boundary-v0 adversarial case set with expiry conditions stated precisely

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** A boundary naming flag triggered an immediate tightening — the cleaner framing was adopted, adversarial cases were mapped against it, and a counterexample caught an overstatement before the case set could be frozen with a flaw built in.
>
> When the relay runs that clean, the whole team moves faster — keep the passes sharp! 🔄
